backend/main.mo: Main Motoko actor implementing user profile management, role-based access control with hardcoded admin principal, admin list management, and a query endpoint that returns a hardcoded Google Sheets URL for admins.
feature_evidence.json: Feature evidence report documenting three implemented features for the TSIC Loggers page: Y-axis limit controls, sensor toggle checkboxes in the legend, and a download button linking to a Google Spreadsheet.
frontend-file-summaries.txt: Comprehensive summaries of frontend files describing the Conceptmachine dashboard with temperature/CO2/fan charts, synchronized zoom controls, date range filtering, and admin-gated access with Google Sheets download links.
frontend/index.css: Global Tailwind CSS styles defining OKLCH color system variables for light and dark modes, including chart colors, olive green accent, and differentiated CO2 series colors.
frontend/index.html: HTML entry point with document title "Conceptmachine Live Data" and root div for React mounting.
frontend/src/App.tsx: Main React application component implementing default-deny admin-only access gating, profile setup modal, login flow, and page-specific Google Sheets download URLs for Conceptmachine and TSIC Loggers pages.
frontend/src/components/AccessDeniedScre: React component displaying an access denied message with shield icon for non-admin users, or a loading spinner while checking permissions, with a button to navigate to the profile page.
frontend/src/components/AuthControls.tsx: Empty or placeholder file for authentication control components.
frontend/src/components/CO2Chart.tsx: Renders a line chart displaying CO2 levels (right, left, and CSV) over time with interactive brush selection and custom tooltips. Uses Recharts library with responsive container and formatted timestamps.
frontend/src/components/CoolingHeatingVe: Displays a line chart for cooling, heating, and ventilation percentages with scaling formulas applied to raw voltage/PWM values. Features dual Y-axis, brush selection, and 0-100% domain for percentage display.
frontend/src/components/DashboardCard.ts: Reusable card component wrapper with header, title, optional header action, and content area. Provides consistent styling with border, shadow, and rounded corners for dashboard layouts.
frontend/src/components/FanVoltageFlowCo: Line chart component showing fan voltages (1-3) and flow control pressure with dual Y-axes (0-10V left, 0-1000Pa right). Includes brush selection and formatted tooltips with units.
frontend/src/components/LogSystemTitleBa: Navigation and control bar for log systems with previous/next buttons, title display, theme toggle, refresh, download (admin-only), and profile menu. Includes special handling for Conceptmachine retention phrase visibility.
frontend/src/components/ProfileMenu.tsx: Dropdown menu component displaying user profile information with options to copy principal ID, navigate to account settings, and sign out. Shows truncated principal and handles authentication state clearing.
frontend/src/components/ProfileSetupModa: Modal dialog for first-time user profile setup requiring name input. Non-dismissible dialog that saves user profile data on form submission.
frontend/src/components/TemperatureChart: Displays a line chart comparing filtered temperature and CSV setpoint data with brush zoom and time-based X-axis formatting.
Renders a multi-line chart for up to 72 TSIC sensors with interactive legend checkboxes, color generation, brush zoom, and configurable Y-axis bounds.
frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts: Manages the backend actor instance with Internet Identity authentication, initializes access control, and invalidates dependent queries on actor changes.
frontend/src/hooks/useAdminList.ts: Fetches the list of all admins from the backend actor, enabled only when the user is confirmed as an admin.
frontend/src/hooks/useCurrentUserProfile: Retrieves the current user's profile from the backend, handling authorization errors gracefully and returning null for unauthorized users.
Subscribes to the temperature-series query cache to derive and format a global last-updated timestamp that persists across navigation.
frontend/src/hooks/useGoogleSheetsDownlo: Fetches the Google Sheets download link from the backend actor with infinite cache staleTime.
frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.t: Provides Internet Identity authentication context with login, logout, and identity state management using AuthClient.
frontend/src/hooks/useIsCallerAdmin.ts: Determines if the current caller is an admin by querying the backend, defaulting to false on any error.
frontend/src/hooks/useLogSystemNavigatio: Manages navigation state for log system pages with previous/next/goto functionality.
frontend/src/hooks/useQueries.ts: Exports user profile queries and mutations for saving profiles and granting admin roles with query invalidation.
frontend/src/hooks/useSyncedTimeWindow.t: Manages a synchronized time window state for chart zooming with start/end indices, reset, and zoom status.
React hook that fetches temperature data using React Query with manual refresh only (no auto-refetch), tracks last updated timestamp, and returns query state and refetch function.
frontend/src/hooks/useThemeSession.ts: React hook that manages dark/light theme state in session storage and synchronizes it with the document's dark class for theme switching.
frontend/src/hooks/useTSICData.ts: Fetches TSIC sensor data for a given ID with infinite staleTime and manual refetch control.
frontend/src/index.css: Tailwind CSS configuration with custom CSS variables for light and dark themes, featuring an olive-green accent color scheme and chart-specific color definitions for temperature, CO2, cooling/heating/ventilation, and flow control.
frontend/src/lib/temperatureDataSource.t: Fetches raw temperature and CO2 data from a Google Apps Script endpoint, validates the response, and parses it into structured TemperatureDataPoint objects.
frontend/src/lib/temperatureParsing.ts: Parses raw temperature, CO2, and HVAC sensor data from API responses, handling comma/dot decimal separators, DD/MM/YY timestamp formats, and converting CO2 values to percentages while filtering invalid data points.
frontend/src/lib/tsicDataParsing.ts: Parses raw TSIC sensor data containing 72 sensor readings per timestamp, validates timestamps, normalizes numeric values, and sorts data points chronologically.
frontend/src/lib/tsicDataSource.ts: Fetches TSIC logger data for a specific ID from a Google Apps Script endpoint and parses it into structured TSICDataPoint objects with 72 sensor readings.
frontend/src/logSystems/logSystemPages.t: Defines the navigation structure for log system pages including Conceptmachine, TSIC Loggers, and Profile pages with their display names, subtitles, and associated components.
frontend/src/main.tsx: Application entry point that sets up React Query, Internet Identity provider, and renders the root App component.
frontend/src/pages/LoginPage.tsx: Login page component that displays a card with Internet Identity authentication button and handles login state, errors, and initialization.
frontend/src/pages/ProfilePage.tsx: Profile page component that displays user information, allows name editing, shows admin status, and provides admin management features including granting admin rights and viewing the admin list with copy-to-clipboard functionality.
frontend/src/pages/TemperatureDashboardP: React page component for temperature dashboard displaying multiple charts (temperature, CO2, cooling/heating/ventilation, fan voltage) with date range filtering and synchronized zoom controls.
frontend/src/pages/TSICLoggersPage.tsx: React page component for TSIC temperature loggers displaying a chart with 72 sensors, featuring ID selection, date range filtering, Y-axis controls, sensor visibility toggles, and zoom/reset functionality.
frontend/src/utils/urlParams.ts: Utility functions for extracting and managing URL parameters from both query strings and hash-based routing, with sessionStorage persistence support for maintaining state across navigation.
frontend/tailwind.config.js: Tailwind CSS configuration defining custom theme extensions including OKLCH color system, typography, container queries, animations, and design tokens for the application's styling.
project_state.json: Project metadata tracking three completed features for TSIC Loggers page: Y-axis limit controls, sensor toggle checkboxes, and download button linking to Google Spreadsheet.
